# Platinum (gpui-platinum)

> Controls for GPUI in the gray, beveled style of late-1990s desktops,
> written in Rust and drawn pixel by pixel. This site shows the library's
> example desktop as GPUI draws it; the desktop itself runs natively, not
> in the browser.

- Crate: gpui-platinum (imported as gpui_platinum); call gpui_platinum::init(cx) before the first window
- Install: gpui-platinum = { git = "https://github.com/firede/gpui-platinum", tag = "v0.2.0" }, with gpui and gpui_platform as gpui-fast and gpui-fast-platform 0.1.12 from crates.io, as the README lists them
- Needs: Rust 2024, gpui-fast v0.1.12 from crates.io; an application's own GPUI dependencies must be that crate too
- Diagrams: the diagram module (default feature "diagram") draws Mermaid diagrams laid out by limu-rs in the look; diagram::layout_options and diagram::view
- License: MIT; bitmap fonts from Platinum Fonts, OFL 1.1
- Languages of the controls' own words: English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean

## Source

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/firede/gpui-platinum/main/README.md): the controls, how to use them, examples, tests
- [API guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/firede/gpui-platinum/main/docs/api.md): state, events, focus, localization, and how it maps from the Go API
- [Design specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/firede/gpui-platinum/main/docs/spec.md): how each control looks and behaves
- [Example: desktop](https://github.com/firede/gpui-platinum/blob/main/examples/desktop.rs): the desk this site shows (cargo run --example desktop -- --lang ja)
- [Example: gallery](https://github.com/firede/gpui-platinum/blob/main/examples/gallery.rs): every control on five pages
- [Example: diagrams](https://github.com/firede/gpui-platinum/blob/main/examples/diagrams.rs): every type of Mermaid diagram limu reads, in the look
- [limu-rs](https://github.com/firede/limu-rs): the Rust diagram layout engine the diagram module draws
- [mygo-platinum](https://github.com/firede/mygo-platinum): the Go original, its design and pictures
- [Platinum Fonts](https://github.com/firede/platinum-fonts): the bitmap faces, Latin and East Asian
